senses.sense_definition: The seed or fruit of a leguminous plant (such as peas, lentils, or beans) eaten as food.

examples.text: Adding a serving of <w>legumes</w> to your daily diet provides high amounts of protein and fiber.
Lentils and chickpeas are common <w>legumes</w> used in vegetarian cooking.

senses.sense_definition: Any plant belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae), typically bearing root nodules with nitrogen-fixing bacteria.

examples.text: Farmers often grow a <w>legume</w> to enrich the soil with essential nitrogen naturally.
Alfalfa is an important forage <w>legume</w> cultivated extensively across the world.

senses.sense_definition: A dry, dehiscent fruit pod that splits open along two sutures, characteristic of the pea family.

examples.text: The dry <w>legume</w> splits open along both seams to release its seeds when mature.
In botanical terms, a pea pod is classified as a true <w>legume</w>.
